lines.japanese: 電話ボックスに入り、きのうヘテロクロミアで渡された名刺の番号を押した。
lines.english: I stepped into a phone booth and dialed the number on the business card I'd been given at Heterochromia the night before.

lines.japanese: 鳴の兄貴は今夜もあの地下室で、音と煙と人いきれにまみれているのだろうか。
lines.english: Was Naru’s brother buried in that basement again tonight, steeped in noise, smoke, and the stifling press of bodies?

lines.japanese: 「あ～い、もっすぃー！　だれ子ちゃん？」
lines.english: “Hiiiya, hellooo! Who's this little darling?”

lines.japanese: 長いこと待たされて電話は繋がった。応じた脳天気な声と、その裏で響く超ボリュームの音楽とが、俺の鼓膜を突きさした──
lines.english: After a long wait, the call finally connected. A carefree voice answered, while deafening music behind it stabbed at both my eardrums—

lines.japanese: ──受話器の向こうは、いくらか防音効果のあるＶＩＰルームではなく、熱狂渦巻くダンスフロアの只中みたいだ。
lines.english: —whoever had the phone wasn’t in the relatively quiet VIP room, but in the thick of the frenzy on the dance floor.

lines.japanese: 「あー俺。成田だけど」
lines.english: “It's me. Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人せんぱい！？　うゥ～っそ、マジでえ！」
lines.english: “Hayato, darling!? No waaay! For real!”

lines.japanese: 「なんでよ、珍しくなーい？　なになに、何の用？　あ、ひょっとして女紹介してくれんの？　え、何センチ？　何カップ？　芸能人で言ったら誰の胸に似てる？」
lines.english: “What’s this? This is rare, isn’t it? Whaddaya want? Oh, are you introducing me to a girl? How big? What cup size? Which celebrity’s chest does hers look like?”

lines.japanese: 「あの。コレって鳳のケータイじゃないの」
lines.english: “Uh. Isn't this Otori's phone?”

lines.japanese: 「アやっべ、そーだったあ！　ごめんちぃ、ちょっと待っててー」
lines.english: “Oh crap, that’s riiight! Sorryyy! Hold on a sec.”

lines.japanese: 政治家か、あのガキ大将は。電話ぐらい自分で出ろ。
lines.english: Was that little gang boss a politician or something? He could answer his own damn phone.

lines.japanese: やかましい音楽を吐きつづけている受話器を、耳から大袈裟に遠ざけて少し待った。
lines.english: I held the receiver theatrically away from my ear and waited as it continued vomiting obnoxious music.

lines.japanese: 「ういーす」
lines.english: “Yo.”

lines.japanese: ゆうべの、あのやる気のない声が聞こえた。また性懲りもなく酒に溺れていたのだろうか、付きあいきれない。俺は挨拶も雑談も飛ばして本題に入る。
lines.english: The same listless voice from last night. Had he gone and drowned himself in booze again without learning a thing? I had no patience for it. I skipped hello and the small talk and went straight to the point.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、いまヘテロにいんだろ」
lines.english: “You're at Hetero right now, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、うんー、よく分かったねー」
lines.english: “Yeah. How'd you know?”

lines.japanese: 馬鹿にしてんのか。この大音量で分からないはずがない。
lines.english: Was he screwing with me? At this volume, how could I not know?

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、いまから俺、ちょっとそっち行くから」
lines.english: “Then I’m heading over now.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんの用？」
lines.english: “What for?”

lines.japanese: 「用っつーか、なんだ……ま、いいや、着いたら話す」
lines.english: “It’s not so much that I need something... I dunno. Whatever. I’ll tell you when I get there.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　なんかつまんなそー。誰かの妹さんの話だったりしてー」
lines.english: “Huh? Sounds boring. This wouldn’t happen to be about somebody’s kid sister, would it?”

lines.japanese: 「……っせえな」
lines.english: “...Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 勘のいいやつだ。
lines.english: Annoyingly perceptive.

lines.japanese: とにかく行くから、と言って俺は電話を切った。そして誰かに尾行されたりしてないか、ちょっとだけ気にしながらピンフ通りの端、ヘテロクロミアへ向かった。
lines.english: I told him I was coming no matter what and hung up. Then, keeping half an eye out for anyone tailing me, I headed for Heterochromia at the end of Pinfu Street.

lines.japanese: やたら腰の低いモテ髭に、お待ちしておりましたと温かく迎えられ、タダで中へ通してもらった。
lines.english: The absurdly obsequious Goatee greeted me warmly with “We’ve been expecting you” and waved me in for free.

lines.japanese: 重いドアを開けるとき、あの暴力的な凄まじい音の波を覚悟して体重をかけたのだけど、予想に反して、フロアにはゆったりしたラウンジ系の曲が控えめなボリュームで流れているだけだった。
lines.english: I put my weight against the heavy door, bracing for that staggering, violent wave of sound. Against all expectations, only an easygoing lounge track played across the floor at a subdued volume.

lines.japanese: まあ、日によって──イベントやＤＪによって──曲のジャンルが変わるのは当たりまえだ。今日はこういうパーティーなんだろうか。それともカッ飛びナンバーの合間に挟まれたチルアウトの時間なのか。
lines.english: Well, of course the genre changed with the day, the event, and the DJ. Maybe this was just tonight's kind of party. Or maybe it was a chillout break between the really wild tracks.

lines.japanese: 俺は音楽に関しちゃ雑食動物だからこだわりはないけど、フロアに集まった男女の数はゆうべより明らかに少なかった。いや、平日の夜なんて普通はこんなもんか。
lines.english: I'm an omnivore when it comes to music, so I didn't care either way. But there were obviously fewer people on the floor than last night. Then again, maybe this is just a normal weeknight.

lines.japanese: バーのカウンターに腕を置いて立っていたロンゲと目が合った。俺は近付いていった。やつと話していたカバーオールの見知らぬデブは、俺に会釈を残してフロアの奥へ去っていった。
lines.english: I caught the eye of the long-haired guy leaning one arm on the bar. I went over. The fat stranger in coveralls who’d been talking to him gave me a nod and headed off toward the back of the floor.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、森里おまえ何してんの」
lines.english: “Huh. Morisato, what are you doing here?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　いや、そりゃこっちの台詞だろ」
lines.english: “Huh? That's my line.”

lines.japanese: 「だっておまえ、ベンキョーは」
lines.english: “What about your stu-dies?”

lines.japanese: やつは目を落として、カウンターテーブルのグラスに手を付けた。中身はウーロン茶に見えた。アルコールが入ってるのかまでは分からない。
lines.english: He lowered his eyes and reached for the glass on the bar. It looked like oolong tea. Whether it had alcohol in it, I couldn’t tell.

lines.japanese: 「そんなん、べつに……まだ受験するって決めたわけじゃねーし。どっちにしたって息抜きは必要だろ」
lines.english: “Doesn’t matter... I haven’t even decided whether I’m taking the entrance exams yet. And either way, everybody needs a break.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そう」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 俺はカウンターの中にいたサイケＴシャツの店員に水を頼んだ。そいつは返事もしないで、輸入物っぽいミネラルウォーターの瓶を掴んだ。嫌な予感がして慌てて尋ねた。
lines.english: I asked the bartender in the psychedelic T-shirt for water. Without a word of acknowledgment, he grabbed a bottle of imported-looking mineral water. Sensing trouble, I quickly asked:

lines.japanese: 「え、ちょっと待って。それ金取んの」
lines.english: “Wait. You charge for that?”

lines.japanese: 店員は目も上げず無言で頷いた。
lines.english: Without looking up or saying a word, the bartender nodded.

lines.japanese: 「うそ、じゃあいい。それいらない。水道水ちょうだい」
lines.english: “Seriously? Then never mind. Don't want it. Give me tap water.”

lines.japanese: 店員がようやく俺を見た。呆れを通りこして苛立った顔をしていた。俺は無視して、目を逸らした。
lines.english: At last the bartender looked at me. He'd gone past disbelief and was getting annoyed. I ignored him and looked away.

lines.japanese: 「で、おまえ、何しに来たん？」
lines.english: “So what'd you come here for?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ちょっと鳳に話あってな。聞いてねーの？」
lines.english: “I need to talk to Otori. He didn't tell you?”

lines.japanese: 「ねーよ。だって翔さん、さっき誰かから電話かかってきたきりＶＩＰルームに──」
lines.english: “No. Kakeru got a call a while ago and went into the VIP room—”

lines.japanese: 「──え、あの電話ってひょっとして成田だった？」
lines.english: “—wait. Was that you on the phone, Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、たぶんそうだと思う」
lines.english: “Yeah. Probably.”

lines.japanese: 「んだよ。なんでおまえが翔さんの番号知ってんだよ」
lines.english: “The hell? Why do you have Kakeru's number?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでじゃねーよ。向こうが勝手に押しつけてきたんだよ」
lines.english: “Don’t ask me. He shoved the number at me.”

lines.japanese: いきなり店員が水の入ったグラスをぞんざいに置いた。ちょっと遠かったから、俺はわざわざ手を伸ばす必要があった。
lines.english: Without warning, the bartender slapped down a glass of water. He set it just far enough away that I had to stretch for it.

lines.japanese: 氷ひとつ入ってない水はぬるくてカルキ臭かった。俺はその感想を声に出したが、店員は気にも留めなかった。
lines.english: The water was lukewarm, without a single cube of ice, and reeked of chlorine. I said so aloud. The bartender didn’t care.

lines.japanese: 「んであのニワトリ、どこ行ったんだよ。ひとがわざわざ事前にアポ取ってやったっつーのに」
lines.english: “So where'd that chicken go? I went to all the trouble of making an appointment first.”

lines.japanese: 「さあな。おまえに会う準備でもしてんじゃねーの。鏡見て、髪セットして」
lines.english: “Who knows. Maybe he's getting ready to see you. Checking the mirror. Doing his hair.”

lines.japanese: 「うぇっ……てめ、気持ち悪ぃこと言ってんじゃねーよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Ugh... Don't say creepy shit like that. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「いやマジで。おまえに会うとき、いっつもそうだから。いま、もう、ＶＩＰルームじゃなくて洗面所かも」
lines.english: “I'm serious. He does it every time he's going to see you. Maybe he's left the VIP room and gone to the bathroom by now.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ。ああ、そう。にしちゃ長くねーか。踏んばりながら寝てんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. Still, he's taking a while. Maybe he fell asleep mid-strain.”

lines.japanese: さっき電話口で聞いた、あの気だるげな声が思いだされる。あの調子じゃ、あながち冗談ではなく本当に酔いつぶれていても不思議じゃない。
lines.english: I remembered that tired voice I'd heard over the phone. The way he sounded, it wouldn't be that surprising if he hadn't been joking and really had passed out drunk.

lines.japanese: 「だって、さっきあいつ、すんげえ酔っぱらってたぞ」
lines.english: “I mean, he sounded completely wasted on the phone.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　んなわけねーだろ。あのひと基本的に酒キライだし、今日だってぜんぜん飲んでなかったもん」
lines.english: “What? No chance. He basically hates alcohol, and he hasn't had a drop today.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、だってアレ、明らかにいつものあいつじゃなかったって。声とか、えれーダルそうだったし」
lines.english: “No, no, I’m telling you, he clearly wasn’t his usual self. Even his voice sounded completely drained.”

lines.japanese: 「ゆうべもそうだったんだけどさ、なんかほら例の、あの芝居くせぇー暑苦しさがねンだよ。あー、そいや服からして違う感じだったな。マジほんと、いつものあいつらしくねーの。おまえは別人かっつーぐらい」
lines.english: He was like that last night too, y'know? Like, that whole theatrical, overbearing heat of his? Gone. Oh, right, his clothes felt different too. Seriously, he just wasn't acting like himself. You'd think he'd turned into somebody else.

lines.japanese: 「いつものあいつねぇ……」
lines.english: “His usual self, huh...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「や、べっつに」
lines.english: “Nah. Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「べつにじゃねーだろ。べつにってツラじゃねーだろソレ。なんだよおまえ、言いたいことあんならはっきり言えよブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。あと髪切れ髪」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘nothing.’ Your face says otherwise. What is it? If you’ve got something to say, spit it out or I’ll fucking kill you, asshole. And cut your hair.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ教えてやるけどな。ハァ？　別人みたい？　いつものあいつじゃない？　ばーか、おまえはいつものあのひとをどんだけ知ってんだよ」
lines.english: “Fine, I’ll tell you. ‘Like another person’? ‘Not his usual self’? Idiot. How much do you even know about what he’s normally like?”

lines.japanese: 「んなこと言ったって、俺はきのう見たんだよ。あいつ、あそこで椅子にだらーっと座って『あははー』とか『なーんだ』とか、すっげキャラ変わってんだぜ。あんなんおまえ、シラフなわけねーだろ」
lines.english: “Say what you like, I saw him yesterday. He was slouched over in a chair right there, going ‘ha ha’ and ‘oh, really?’ His whole personality had changed. No way in hell he was sober.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえさあ、発想の転換って知ってる？　ちったぁアタマ使えって。話はそれからだよ」
lines.english: “You ever heard of changing your perspective? Use your head for once. Then we'll talk.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　んだてめ、糞ロンゲがいちいち偉っそうに。髪切れ髪」
lines.english: “The hell? Listen to this long-haired asshole talking down to me. Cut your hair.”

lines.japanese: 「あーっ！　隼人君だー！」
lines.english: “Ah! It's Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「うわー、こんなとこ来てるー。ふりょー、超ふりょー」
lines.english: “Whoa, you came to a place like this! Look at you, delinquent. Total delinquent.”

lines.japanese: 見慣れない格好をした亜衣だった。ベストの下の白いブラウスは襟元がだらしなく開いていて、タイが無造作に絡みついている。下は鳴のと同じ、タータンチェックのミニだった。
lines.english: Ai was wearing clothes I'd never seen on her. The white blouse beneath her vest hung carelessly open at the collar, a tie looped loosely around it. Below was a tartan miniskirt like Naru's.

lines.japanese: 気分よく踊っていたのか、上気した肌にはうっすら汗が浮かんでいた。こんな時間にこんな場所で……しょーがねえやつだ。まあ、背伸びしたい年頃なんだろう。
lines.english: Maybe she'd been enjoying herself dancing. A faint sheen of sweat covered her flushed skin. Here, at this hour... Hopeless girl. Well, she was at the age when you wanted to play grown-up.

lines.japanese: 「つか、制服なんか着ててよく追いだされねーな。どんだけだよ。マジ終わってんな、この店」
lines.english: I mean, you're wearing a school uniform and they haven't kicked you out. How far gone is this place? Seriously, it's finished.

lines.japanese: あれ、いや、こいつが制服なんか着てるってことは……。
lines.english: Wait. If she was wearing her uniform, then...

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。おまえ、きょう学校行ってきたの」
lines.english: “What, did you go to school today?”

lines.japanese: 「ん～？　んん～っ？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Hmmmm?”

lines.japanese: 俺が珍しい格好の香田亜衣を見下ろしていると、やつは不意に口を横へ広げるようにして笑った。
lines.english: As I looked down at Ai Koda in her unfamiliar clothes, she suddenly spread her mouth sideways in a grin.

lines.japanese: 「……あ？　なんだよ」
lines.english: “...What? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「へへー。見てる見てる。熱視線、熱視線」
lines.english: “Heh heh. You're looking. Burning a hole straight through me.”

lines.japanese: 俺の目玉から自分の体まで、人差し指で勝手に見えない導線を敷いて、にやにやと笑いだした。意味が分からない。
lines.english: With one index finger, she drew an imaginary sight line from my eyeballs to her body and began to grin. I had no idea what she meant.

lines.japanese: 「はァ～！　やっぱりキミは制服かぁ～！」
lines.english: “Aha! So it *is* uniforms with you!”

lines.japanese: いや、ほんと意味分かんない。
lines.english: No, seriously. I had no idea what she meant.

lines.japanese: 「あーもー暑ぅい、めちゃ暑ぅーい。脱いどくー？　脱がれとくー？」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sooo hot. Way too hot. Should I strip? Should I let myself be stripped?”

lines.japanese: なぜか俺の目をちらちら窺いながら、亜衣は両手でベストの裾を摘み、はたはたと空気を送りこむように扇ぎだした。
lines.english: For some reason, Ai kept stealing glances at me as she pinched the hem of her vest in both hands and flapped air beneath it.

lines.japanese: 「やめとけって。おまえ、汗かいてんじゃん。ブラ線見えんぞ」
lines.english: “Don't. You're sweaty. Your bra's showing through.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、見たいー？」
lines.english: “Hayato, want to see?”

lines.japanese: 「全然」
lines.english: “Not remotely.”

lines.japanese: つーか、俺に聞くな。
lines.english: And don’t ask me.

lines.japanese: 「だーよねえ。隼人君が見たいのはそーゆんじゃないもんねえ」
lines.english: “Riiight. That's not the kind of thing Hayato wants to see.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　なんだよ」
lines.english: “Huh? What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「あっはーい、も、しょンがないしー。ちょっと、待っときー」
lines.english: “Okaaay. Oh well, can't be helped. Wait right here.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　おぉ亜衣、どこ行くんだよ！」
lines.english: “Huh? Hey, Ai, where’re you going?”

lines.japanese: 「すぐ戻りー」
lines.english: “Be right back.”

lines.japanese: やつは二本の腕で「Ｔ」の字を作った。ＴはタイムのＴ。もしくはトイレのＴ。一時離脱のサインを残して、小娘は洗面所やコインロッカーに続く狭苦しい通廊へ走っていった。
lines.english: She made a T with both arms. T for time-out. Or T for toilet. Leaving behind the sign of her temporary departure, the little girl ran down the cramped corridor leading to the bathrooms and coin lockers.

lines.japanese: 「なんだあれ」
lines.english: “What was that?”

lines.japanese: 「知るか」
lines.english: “How should I know?”

lines.japanese: 森里は今日もご機嫌ななめみたいだ。知ったこっちゃねーけど。
lines.english: Morisato seemed to be in a foul mood again today. Not that I cared.

lines.japanese: 俺はフロアの中ほどや壁際のまったり席を見渡した。見覚えのあるハゲやドレッドはいたけど、肝心のバカ殿がお見えにならない。
lines.english: I surveyed the middle of the floor and the lounge seats along the walls. I recognized a familiar bald head and familiar dreadlocks, but His Idiot Highness was nowhere to be seen.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。鳳はいつ戻ってくんだよ」
lines.english: “Hey. When’s Otori coming back?”

lines.japanese: 森里に詰問すると、やつはウーロン茶だかウーロンハイだかをひと口含んでから、いかにもどうでもよさげな調子で答えた。
lines.english: I pressed Morisato. He took a sip of whatever was in his glass—oolong tea or shochu with oolong—then answered like none of it mattered.

lines.japanese: 「さあ、そろそろじゃねーの。いつもはだいたい食ってから、そーなあ、三十分ぐれーでアガってくる感じかあ？」
lines.english: “Who knows. Soon, probably. Usually he comes up about… yeah, half an hour after he eats it.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　食うってなにを」
lines.english: “Huh? Eats what?”
“Paper.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なんの紙だよ。なんで紙なんか食うんだよ。ヤギかあいつ。ミルク絞んぞクソが。おまえ、ヤギミルクなめんなよ。あれ牛の乳よりおなかに優しいから、お子様にも安心してお飲みいただけんぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “What? What paper? Why would he eat paper? Is he a goat? I'll milk the bastard. Don't you underestimate goat's milk—it's easier on the stomach than cow's milk, and may be safely enjoyed even by your precious little ones, asshole.”

lines.japanese: <10>\「やぎみるくー！」
lines.english: “Goat’s miiilk!”

lines.japanese: 「いてっ」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 背中にちゃちい肘鉄のような衝撃を受けた。俺は大袈裟に痛がってみせながら振りむいた。
lines.english: A flimsy elbow-like impact struck my back. I turned with an exaggerated show of pain.

lines.japanese: 「じゃーん！　全国一千万制服マニアのおにいさん、お待たせぇ！　ついに本邦初公開、これがフルアーマー亜衣ちゃんでぇす！　亜衣ぽんって呼んでねー！　さあみんな一緒にぃー、ハイ、せぇーのぉーっ！」
lines.english: “Ta-da! All ten million uniform-loving gentlemen across the nation, sorry to keep you waiting! At long last, her first unveiling in Japan: Full-Armor Ai! Call me Ai-Ai! All together now—ready, set!”

lines.japanese: 「あんさ森里さ、ヤギって仔ヤギの時点でもう老け顔なんかな」
lines.english: “Hey, Morisato. You think goats already have old-man faces when they're kids?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「おいィィ！　聞けよう！」
lines.english: “Heeey! Listen to me!”

lines.japanese: 「うぉっと！」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 木漏れ日みたいなタックルが、俺の体を前へ突きとばした。大きくよろめいてやると、その先に立っていた森里は露骨に舌打ちしながら、大きく横へよけた。シャレの分からないやつだ。
lines.english: A tackle as soft as sunlight through leaves nudged me forward. I made a big show of stumbling, but Morisato clicked his tongue and moved way off to the side. Guy couldn't take a joke.

lines.japanese: 「亜衣おまえ、暑い暑い言いながら、なんで上着てきてんだよ」
lines.english: “Ai, you kept saying you were hot. Why'd you go put on another layer?”

lines.japanese: 「な。そんな汗だくの顔してな。おう、暑いんだろ。無理してねーで脱げよ。安心しろ。おまえのつまんねえ乳バンドが透けてようが、そんなん誰も見ねえから」
lines.english: “Yeah. You're sweating like crazy. If you're hot, take it off. Relax. Even if that boring bra shows through, nobody's looking.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふん？　きのうは直でばっち見やがったくせに？」
lines.english: “Hmm? You stared plenty hard at everything yesterday.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「しかも上下とも超ガン見」
lines.english: “Top and bottom. Really stared.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……え、なんだそれ」
lines.english: “Wait... What the hell is that about?”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな。なんでもねえよ」
lines.english: “Shut up. It was nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「いひひ、こーいつ照れんなしー」
lines.english: “Ihihi. Look at you getting all shy.”

lines.japanese: ブレザーの肘がつんつんと俺の脇腹を突付いた。俺はぬるい水を飲んだ。森里が冷たく目をすがめていた。
lines.english: The elbow of her blazer prodded my side. I drank the lukewarm water. Morisato narrowed cold eyes at me.

lines.japanese: 「でもホントは隼人君、そんな刺激的なのより、こういうガクセーっぽいのがお好みなんだもんねー」
lines.english: But reaaally, Hayato likes nice student-y stuff like this more than anything too racy, don't youuu?

lines.japanese: 亜衣が両手を斜めに開いて、くるっとターンした。短いスカートがパラソルみたいに広がって──
lines.english: Ai opened both arms on a diagonal and twirled. Her short skirt spread like a parasol—

lines.japanese: 「ああー、あー、なあ成田、あの、ぼちぼちフロア行かね？」
lines.english: “Oh—hey, Narita. Don't you think we oughta head out onto the floor?”

lines.japanese: 「え、いいけど何おまえ、俺と踊りたいの」
lines.english: “Sure, but what—you want to dance with me?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつに」
lines.english: “No. Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「……だよな」
lines.english: “...Thought not.”

lines.japanese: なら気持ち悪いこと言うな。
lines.english: Then don’t say creepy shit like that.

lines.japanese: 「えー、じゃあ隼人君、私と行こーよ。今日のＤＪ超わかってて？　も、空気の持ってき方ヤバいヤバい」
lines.english: “What? Then come with me, Hayato. Tonight’s DJ totally gets it, you know? The way he builds the room is unreal.”

lines.japanese: 「はァ？　いいよ俺、こういうオサレくせえ曲のノリよく分かんねーし。おまえら、ふたりで行ってこいよ」
lines.english: “Huh? No thanks. I don't know how you're supposed to move to this pretentious crap. You two go together.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー」
lines.english: “Aww.”

lines.japanese: 「えーじゃねえだろ。そこでえーはヘコむわ、マジで」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘aww’ right there. That’s seriously depressing.”

lines.japanese: 森里が背中を向けてグラスを呷った。すでに中身は空だった。氷がいくつか、やつの口の中に落ちた。
lines.english: Morisato turned his back and tipped up his glass. It was already empty. Several ice cubes tumbled into his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「あ、違う違う違う！　カズ君がやだとか、それ気な意味じゃなくて。ほんとほんと、ほんとだよ？」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, no! I didn't mean I don't want to go with Kazu. Really, really. I mean it, okay?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣が慰めるように言葉を付けたした。森里はごりごり音を立てて氷を噛みくだいた。
lines.english: Ai hurried to reassure him. Morisato crunched the ice noisily between his teeth.

lines.japanese: 「いや、フォローいらねーよ。こっちだって冗談だっつの」
lines.english: “You don’t need to make me feel better. I was joking too.”

lines.japanese: 「だしょー？　だったよねー、ははー」
lines.english: “R-right? That's what I thought. Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: なんだこの空気。
lines.english: What the hell was with this tension?

lines.japanese: 森里は空のグラスを強く置いて、店員になにか新しいドリンクを注文した。亜衣がこっそり俺に向けて、片目をすぼめるように笑った。たはは。
lines.english: Morisato set the empty glass down hard and ordered something new from the bartender. Ai shot me a furtive, sheepish wink. Heh.

lines.japanese: 俺は笑いかえさず、タコ踊りしてる客の群れへ向けて顎を振った。
lines.english: I didn't smile back. I jerked my chin toward the mass of customers flailing like octopuses.

lines.japanese: 「だから、亜衣、俺はいいから行けって。森里とふたりで適当にハジけてこいよ」
lines.english: “Like I said, Ai, forget me and go. You and Morisato can cut loose together.”
“Okay...”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は困り顔で幼なじみの背中をうかがった。森里は長い髪を後ろに掻きあげながら、風に揺れる蝋燭の火みたいにゆっくりと振りかえった。
lines.english: Looking troubled, Ai glanced at her childhood friend’s back. Morisato swept his long hair behind him and slowly turned, like a candle flame wavering in the wind.

lines.japanese: 俺は睨まれた。しかし、それは攻撃的な眼光ではなかった。もっと弱々しい、すがるような視線だった。
lines.english: Morisato’s eyes fixed on me. There was nothing aggressive in them. It was a weaker look, almost pleading.

lines.japanese: その目が次の瞬間、俺を通りすぎて見開かれた。その視点を追って振りかえると、そこには血走ったふたつの眼球があった。
lines.english: An instant later, his gaze slid past me and his eyes went wide. I followed it and turned to find a pair of bloodshot eyes staring back.

lines.japanese: 「ハッハー！　ようこそアミーゴ、楽園の門へ！　ハハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha! Welcome, amigo, to the gates of paradise! Ha ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: ほの赤い閃光がまたたく暗がりの中、長身の男が不気味な笑みを浮かべながら右手を掲げた。フレイムバーズのハンドサイン。
lines.english: In the dark, lit by dim red flashes, the tall man raised his right hand with an eerie smile. The Flame Birds’ hand sign.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　沁みる音、融ける光、香る大気！　今宵は稀に見るグッドトリップだ！　敬虔なる司祭よ、忠臣たる民衆よ。前奏曲は終わりだ。貴き俺に讃歌を奉げろ！　フェニックスの頌歌！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Sound that sinks into you! Melting light! Fragrant air! Tonight is a rare good trip! Devout priests! Loyal subjects! The prelude is over. Offer me, your exalted lord, a hymn! An ode to the Phoenix!”

lines.japanese: やつは頭上の右手を、コンサートホールの指揮者のようにひらりと裏返した。ＤＪブースの中で痩せた白人が、にやりと鳳に笑いかけて親指を立てる。
lines.english: He flipped his raised hand over with a flourish, like a conductor in a concert hall. In the DJ booth, a gaunt white man grinned at Otori and gave him a thumbs-up.

lines.japanese: イージーリスニングのように主張しなかった上品で安らかな旋律に、ふうっとさりげなく、それでいて圧倒的に力強いホーンの音色が襲いかかった。
lines.english: Until then, the elegant, soothing melody had been as unobtrusive as easy listening. Then a horn swept in—casually, almost imperceptibly, yet with overwhelming force.

lines.japanese: 瞬間、ゆるやかに優しく揺れていたクラウドが、一斉に飛びあがって狂喜の叫びをあげた。
lines.english: In that instant, the crowd that had been swaying gently sprang as one and screamed in ecstasy.

lines.japanese: 熱気が湧きおこる。そのイントロは、やつらにとってお馴染みのキラーアンセムだったようだ。手足を振りまわして、まるで天井から一万円札でも降ってきたかのような騒ぎだ。
lines.english: Heat surged. The intro was evidently one of the killer anthems they all knew. Arms and legs flew as if ten-thousand-yen notes had begun raining from the ceiling.

lines.japanese: ドン！　ドン！　ドン！　ドン！
lines.english: Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!

lines.japanese: 巨象の行進めいた四分打ちのバスドラが、セレブなペルシャ猫みたいに気取ったメロディを次々に呑みこみ踏みつぶしてゆく。圧巻だ。怒涛のダンスビートと聴衆の叫びが、たちまちフロアの温度をぶち上げていった。
lines.english: A four-on-the-floor kick like the march of a colossal elephant swallowed and trampled one melody after another, each as affected as a pampered Persian cat. It was magnificent. The raging dance beat and the audience's screams drove the room's temperature through the roof in seconds.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ、舞え聴衆！　音と交わり、光に嬲られ、狂乱の匂いに犯されろ！　その恍惚と官能こそが始原の悦びだ！　全身で味わえ、貪りつくせっ！　ハーハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha! Dance, my audience! Couple with the sound, let the light ravish you, let the scent of frenzy violate you! That rapture and sensuality are pleasure in its primal form! Taste it with your whole body! Gorge yourself on it! Haa-ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: プシューウ！　涼やかな噴射音と共に、天井からドライアイスの白煙が吹きつけてきた。フロアは一瞬白い靄に埋もれ、誰かが華麗に振りまわすケミカルライトの蛍光ピンクしか見えなくなった。
lines.english: Pssshhh! With a cool hiss, white dry-ice smoke blasted from the ceiling. For an instant the floor vanished into pale haze, leaving only the fluorescent pink of a glow stick someone whirled with dazzling skill.

lines.japanese: 「え、ええー」
lines.english: “Uh... wow.”

lines.japanese: しかし鳳やフロアの客が昂ぶるほど、俺は逆に引いていった。
lines.english: Yet the more worked up Otori and the crowd became, the farther I recoiled.

lines.japanese: 芝居じみた哄笑と圧倒的な存在感。これぞまさしくいつもの──いや、むしろいつも以上の鳳翔だった。白い闇が薄まると、俺はいつものように、四流芸人のサムい一発芸を眺めるような視線をやつに送った。
lines.english: That theatrical peal of laughter. That overwhelming presence. Here was the usual Kakeru Otori—no, more Kakeru Otori than ever. As the white darkness thinned, I gave him the look I always did: the look you gave a fourth-rate comic performing a painfully dead gag.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　いつの夜も安気だな隼人！　おまえの瞳は何処を見ている！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Carefree as ever, Hayato! Where are those eyes of yours looking?”

lines.japanese: 俺はなにか言おうとしたが、腹の皮を震わせるほどの音に挑むのも馬鹿らしい気がして、声が喉から出てこなかった。俺のハートは震えない。
lines.english: I opened my mouth to answer, then decided it wasn’t worth shouting over noise loud enough to rattle my guts. The beat shook my body, but not my heart.

lines.japanese: 鳳がなにか言った。聞こえなかったが、身振りで俺を誘っていると分かった。
lines.english: Otori said something. I couldn’t hear it, but his gesture made it clear that he was beckoning me.

lines.japanese: やつが歩きだすと自然に群衆が分かれ、フロアに道が開けてゆく。俺はゆうべの陰気な鳳翔を回想しながらそのあとを追った。
lines.english: When he began to walk, the crowd parted naturally, opening a path across the floor. Remembering the gloomy Kakeru Otori of the night before, I followed.
